status: Experimental source reproduction only; not applied to the QVAC engine dependency.
isolation: Restore the control TransformerBlock and its segment modulation/residual helpers on the candidate revision. Retain candidate attention views, fused SwiGLU, partial RoPE, shared runner and ggml changes.
integration_limit: Not a patch against the pinned QVAC engine. Preserve QVAC-specific GGUF and audio behavior in any future backport, and validate shared-engine consumers before updating a package pin.
measurement_scope: Fresh CLI processes; report generation time separately from process wall time and addon warm-request latency.
acceptance: Compare repeated outputs, video/audio metrics, latency and memory to the matched control. Passing this experiment does not validate all models, backends or a QVAC engine upgrade.
patch_format: Zero context avoids whitespace-only context lines in the stored research artifact; resulting source is unchanged.
